Home » Why Frisco
FRISCO, TXAmerica’s Premier Destination
Frisco, Texas, emerges as a beacon of opportunity in the real estate realm, where rapid growth harmonizes with sustainable living and economic vitality. Recognized as the best place to live in America, Frisco embodies safety, family values, and limitless potential, drawing in ambitious homeowners and businesses alike. The city's rapid expansion is complemented by its dedication to education and recreation, boasting top-tier schools, expansive parks, and diverse cultural offerings.Frisco's business-friendly environment, marked by the presence of Fortune 500 companies and a thriving job market, coupled with its absence of state income tax, further amplifies its appeal as an investment destination. Master-planned communities, state-of-the-art sports venues, and an unparalleled retail landscape solidify Frisco's position as a premier real estate market. With its vibrant community spirit, economic dynamism, and forward-looking vision, Frisco isn't just keeping pace—it's setting the standard in the global real estate arena.

Safety
Frisco repeatedly ranks among the highest for safest cities in the U.S. With it’s low crime rates and well-maintained neighborhoods, it provides a secure environment for families.
Economy
Frisco, Texas, has experienced remarkable economic growth driven by major expansion, boasting low unemployment rates, high average household income, strong support for local businesses, innovative developments like Fields, and the Omni PGA Frisco Resort, making it a thriving and desirable community.
Community
Frisco has a vibrant and welcoming community atmosphere, with ample family-friendly amenities and events, fostering a sense of belonging and connection among residents. View Grand Park details
Sports City, USA
Frisco, acclaimed as Sports City USA, embodies a dynamic, progressive ethos driven by sports. The city offers abundant sports and recreational opportunities, including youth leagues and professional venues, catering to sports enthusiasts of all ages.
Schools
Frisco’s top-rated school system consistently ranks among the best in the state, offering quality education and numerous academic and extracurricular opportunities for students.
Quality of Life
With its combination of safety, sports, excellent schools, and community spirit, Frisco emerges as one of the best places for families to live, offering an enriching and fulfilling lifestyle.

The Preserve
OVERVIEW OF FIELDSNorth Texas' Premier Living ExperienceFields represents a unique opportunity to immerse in the best of North Texas. This esteemed community, spanning nearly 2,500 acres, is steeped in the rich history of the region. Named in honor of Bert Fields, Jr., its landscape is a testament to his vision and dedication. Fields is a harmonious blend of past and future, offering a modern living experience while honoring its roots.Fields is strategically situated to leverage the growth trajectory of the region. It boasts a diverse array of experiences, from a dynamic town center to serene neighborhoods, all intricately woven into the North Texas landscape. Located at the nexus of major roadways, Fields is your gateway to unparalleled employment, housing, and recreational opportunities.
Preserve Features
PGA Golf Courses
The Preserve boasts two impressive PGA golf courses, beautifully integrated into the landscape, providing a top-tier golfing experience at Fields’ core.
Trails
The Preserve’s trails, featuring overlooks of the golf courses, invite residents to connect with nature.
The Preserve’s Landscape
The open-space framework of Fields, particularly in The Preserve, is intentionally designed to cultivate a unique, tranquil landscape with large canopy trees and ornamental understory.
Guard Gated Community
The Preserve’s entrances are meticulously designed for elegance and security. Gated entries, stone walls, and lush plantings create a welcoming yet exclusive atmosphere.
Neighborhood Canopies
In The Preserve, tree-lined streets and sidewalks offer both beauty and functionality, providing shade and enhancing navigation with thoughtfully selected tree species.
Recreational Spaces
Open spaces in The Preserve are adorned with pavilions, water features, and pergolas, providing residents with serene spots for relaxation and protection from the elements.
Parkside VillasVentura unveils Parkside Villas, an exquisite enclave within The Preserve of Fields Frisco, featuring five distinct prototype designs along the Boulevard. These prototypes showcase innovative architectural concepts, notably the "front yard living" concept, which is groundbreaking in the DFW area.Developed in close collaboration with SHM Architects, these villas have swiftly garnered approval for construction. Each residence within Parkside Villas boasts its unique architectural identity, ranging from the sleek lines of Santa Barbara Modern to the urban sophistication of Manhattan Penthouse, the vibrant aesthetics of Miami Contemporary, the coastal charm of Newport Coastal, and the opulent flair of Dubai Chic. All of these spectacular designs are currently available for sale.
FilterPreserve Santa Barbara Modern Manhattan Penthouse Miami Contemporary Newport Coastal Dubai Chic Aspen
Additional Preserve LotsAside from Parkside Villas, Ventura is excited to be positioned well in the other areas of the Preserve including:
GOLF COURSE (1 Lot): Half-acre lots adjacent to the PGA golf course offer stunning views for those who value both scenic vistas and spacious luxury. (highlighted in green)
NEIGHBORHOOD (SOLD): Traditional luxury with the beauty of The Preserve’s natural setting. Access to exclusive amenities and more. (highlighted in yellow)
HILLTOP (5 Lots): These exclusive lots epitomize luxury, averaging just under an acre in size and elevated to offer stunning views. Ideal for affluent individuals seeking grandeur and privacy. (highlighted in blue)
BOULEVARD (17 Lots): Featuring exceptional landscaping and innovative designs, Boulevard residences boast five unique modern styles ready for post-lot purchase construction. Uniquely, these homes are distinguished by front yard living and distinct architectural concepts. (highlighted in red)

FRISCOLakes of LegacyThe Lakes on Legacy Drive is a master-planned gated community like no other. A series of breathtaking, connected lakes and trails provide a soothing backdrop to an expertly crafted collection of luxury homes. Being one of the last few lots remaining in this community, 3998 Touraine sits high, backing to a lake, siding to a waterfall and park, with a design possibility of 270-degree breathtaking panoramic views. It is possibly one of the last lots in Frisco offering such incredible views of water from every room.A championship golf course, world-class tennis academy, and fitness center are within walking distance. Lakes on Legacy is just north of Stonebriar Country Club and one mile west of Legacy Business Park and the Dallas North Tollway. Downtown Dallas is just 30 minutes away, while DFW and Dallas Love Field airports are even closer. 3998 Touraine Drive View On Map
